operationLock.aGitOperationIsAlreadyRunn.en: A Git operation is already running for this repository in another AlwayGit window.
operationLock.aGitOperationIsAlreadyRunn.zh-CN: 此仓库已有 Git 操作正在另一个 AlwayGit 窗口中运行。

operationLock.thePreviousGitOperationWas.en: The previous Git operation was interrupted. Confirm that its Git processes have ended and inspect the repository before removing its protection.
operationLock.thePreviousGitOperationWas.zh-CN: 上一次 Git 操作已中断。移除保护前，请确认其 Git 进程均已结束并检查仓库状态。
